⭐ Labamba Fashion – Brigade Road, Bengaluru
Fashion boutique situated on Brigade Road.
Stylish collection of casual and party-wear outfits. …
Amazing store for all things fashion, he had good 2026 collection jerseys and really loved the Fifa patches I purchased from them. Loved the experience and the store has a lot to offer.

Was looking for a place which customize jerseys and got guided to this place. Seeing the name reminded me of my company's association with them over the decades for goodies. Good collections of small gifts and amazing logo, names can be imprinted on bags shirts jackets coffee mugs etc. Very friendly and helpful staff.
